question: Who was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in the field of Art-Acting-Theatre for the year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balwant Moreshwar Purandare**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Balwant Moreshwar Purandare was awarded the Padma Vibhushan **in the field of Art-Acting-Theatre in 2019.
 
• He is popularly known as Babasaheb Purandare.
 
• He is known for his books like 'Raja Shiv Chhatrapati', 'Purandaryanchi Daulat', 'Purandaryanchi Naubat' and 'Gadsanch'.
 
• The Maharashtra government had bestowed the ‘Maharashtra Bhushan’, the state’s highest honour, on Purandare in 2015.
 
• Along with him, 3 other people were awarded Padma Vibhushan in 2019.
